overview: A text link for navigating to other pages, sections, or external resources within body copy and rich text.

whenToUse: For any navigation to another URL, page, or in-page anchor embedded within body copy or standalone
When you need an inline text link that fits naturally within a sentence or paragraph
do: Write descriptive, meaningful link text that communicates the destination without surrounding context (e.g. "View network map", not "click here")
Use the branded variant for standalone or prominent links that sit outside of body copy and need visual weight
Use the copy variant for links that should blend with surrounding text color without the default underline treatment
Reflect visit history with the visited prop where relevant so users know which destinations they've already navigated to
dont: Don't use a link for actions that change application state — use a Button instead
Don't use generic link text like "click here" or "read more" — it's inaccessible to screen reader users navigating by links
Don't open links in a new tab without signaling it to the user (e.g. an external link icon and descriptive aria-label)
